marketing_description: The DeWALT DCLE34031B 3x360 Line Laser features a self-leveling cross-line laser projection with 3 green lines, providing a working range of 130 ft without a detector and 330 ft with a detector, and has an accuracy of +/-1/8 in at 30 ft. This laser is powered by a 20 V battery and has an IP54 rating. It measures 14-in x 10.9-in x 5-1/2-in.
